Lemma
[Distance circles near the center of a neck] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0114, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0115 1. ch29:29.26\group Backward Geometry

For every $\delta >0$, sufficiently good neck coordinates make the relevant distance circles $C^0$-close to cylindrical cross-sections and make their lengths $\delta $-close to the cylindrical circumference.
